items.title: Dashboard
items.text: Open Dashboard in the tray menu: server health, activity, approvals.

items.title: A new look
items.text: Tiro now looks like the Tiro web app: dark slate, one cyan accent, clean panels.

items.title: Cleaner bubbles and cards
items.text: No more glow, glass or dither. Text is sharper and easier to read.

items.title: Green mic waveform
items.text: While I listen, four green bars show your voice.

items.title: All Tiro now
items.text: Tiro desktop is its own app, split from Roamies. Credit to Ken Kai on the About page.

items.title: Your settings moved
items.text: Settings, memory and logs now live in your .tiro folder. Nothing was lost.

items.title: Other looks
items.text: Roamies' other looks are gone. Tiro is the one look, with its own voice.

items.title: Focus and game mode
items.text: Focus blocks and the game sidebar were removed.

items.title: Mac and Linux
items.text: Tiro desktop is built for Windows only now.
